One aggregator (stockanalysis) labeled net debt as -$1.09B which appears to be a sign error; arithmetic confirms positive net debt. DROP CLASSIFICATION = fear_rotation: stock is ~37% off its 52-wk high ($745.61) / ~36% off ATH close ($733.60) yet fundamentals are ACCELERATING (Q1'26 rev +59%, FY25 +70%, ~78% op margin, ~72% FCF margin, strong Q2 guide, $1B buyback in Q1). The drawdown reflects momentum/multiple de-rating and rotation out of high-flyers plus lingering short-report sentiment, not business deterioration. SBC is very low for software (~3.8% of revenue / ~5.3% of FCF) — favorable for R9. Price as-of intraday Jun 22, 2026; market cap $157.7B.
